Congress was built to serve the people - not protect the powerful. And it has operated in the shadows for far too long, and that darkness ends now. No member and no party gets a pass any more.

Sunlight is the best disinfectant. And we're bringing it.

Our shrimpers and fishermen should never have to struggle to compete with foreign competitors undercutting them while Washington looks the other way. We're making sure they don't have to.

South Carolina STRONG.

Video

Over 80% of Americans support voter ID.

95% of Republicans. 71% of Democrats.

The AMERICAN people. This is a no-brainer.

The Senate needs to pass the SAVE America Act and get it to the President's desk before midterms. The integrity of our democracy depends on it.

President Trump has been successful with Iran. We saw him do it with Soleimani and with Maduro in Venezuela. He gets in, he gets out.

Iran now has basically no navy, no air force, and no ground game. President Trump has done this with extraordinary strength and we commend him for it.

Video

Deuteronomy 31:6 "Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the Lord your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you."

Our lord and savior is with us always. He makes us strong.

Today marks one year since Logan Federico was taken from us.

She was 22 years old. A young woman with everything ahead of her, gone because a violent career criminal with nearly 40 prior arrests was allowed to walk free. Not once. Not twice. Nearly 40 times.

The people responsible for keeping him off the streets chose to let him walk free. Again and again. Logan Federico paid the price.

The system failed her. We will not forget her.

To her family, our hearts are with you today. We will never

Veterans don't stop serving when they come home, and we shouldn't stop serving them.

Our office participated in the Flying Frog 5K this past weekend, a patriotic runway race at Beaufort Executive Airport supporting Operation Patriots FOB and their mission to fight veteran suicide head-on.

We ran for them. Every single step counted.

South Carolina STRONG.

Our Violet's Law amendment passed the House and has made it into the House-passed Farm Bill.

From day one in Congress, we have worked to end taxpayer-funded animal abuse. Violet's Law ensures dogs, cats, primates, hamsters, guinea pigs, and rabbits used in federally research facilities are retired and re-homed, including through animal rescue organizations, shelters and sanctuaries, rather than euthanized when their time in government labs ends.

These animals deserve a second chance.

Video

Release the unredacted files. Prosecute the predators. Make the arrests.

The victims of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell have waited too long for justice. We made a personal promise to them and to ourselves to never stop until we deliver the accountability they deserve.

We won't stop until they get the justice they deserve.

Thank you, President Trump, for putting South Carolina fishermen first. 🎣


Eric Daugherty (@EricLDaugh)

His answer to too many questions was “I do not recall."

A billionaire with a close relationship to one of the most notorious enablers of child sex trafficking in history who visited the home of the former President of the United States, and his memory just happens to fail him. Particularly convenient.

These beagles spent their lives in a lab.

Now, their world has changed. They touched grass for the first time and have a lifetime of love and safety ahead of them.

In Congress, we've pushed for legislation to end cruel animal research and continued to be a voice in Washington for the voiceless.

This is a HUGE milestone for animal welfare. You're safe now. 🐾


Dean Guzman Wyrzykowski (@deanguzmanw)

SNAP stands for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program. Nutrition. Not sugar.

The House voted to keep taxpayer dollars funding sugary drinks like soda for SNAP recipients. We voted NO.

Taxpayers funding a nutrition program deserve to know those dollars are actually buying nutritious food. SNAP exists to put nutritious food on the table for families who need it, not to subsidize garbage with zero nutritional value and fuel obesity rates.

If you want a soda, buy it on your own dime.

Hurricane season is just around the corner.

We want every Lowcountry family to be safe and prepared for whatever this season brings. Get your plan in place now before June 1st.

South Carolina STRONG.


SC Emergency Management Division (@SCEMD)

South Carolina is getting ready for hurricane season.
Have a plan in place.
Gather your emergency supplies.
Stay connected and informed.
Get more hurricane prep tips at: hurricane.sc/
#HurricanePrep #SCPrepared #emergencypreps #Hurricaneprepmonth #SCWX

More than half a million South Carolinians rely on SNAP to put food on the table. In just the first quarter of FY 2025, there were 4,209 instances of stolen SNAP benefits in our state alone.

We introduced the FAIR Act to crack down on fraud by requiring a photo ID on every EBT card, ensuring benefits are only redeemed by those who are legally eligible to receive them and taxpayer dollars are protected, not stolen.


Dept. of Agriculture (@USDA)

USDA is committed to respecting American taxpayer

We will not sit by and allow our children to be poisoned every time they eat. 

We are fully aligned with President Trump and Secretary Kennedy's Make America Healthy Again agenda. 

It starts with getting pesticides out of our food.
